name: iter_vary_coverage_schedule
description: The companion paper's named future work, made concrete: 'iterating the loop with a schedule that relaxes focus as the weak region shrinks ... expressible through either coverage control'. Sweeps the rehearsal-mix schedule (constant / linear / exponential decay / increase / adaptive-to-severity) against the starting mix, at the operating point. The adaptive schedule reads the weakspot's severity from the model's own error distribution — mean error inside the detected region over mean error outside — so it never touches ground truth and stays implementable on a fixed dataset. Accumulative regime, 8 iterations, one detector, 10 seeds.
